entries.title: Gift Cards — Selling / Issuing a Gift Card (SOP)
entries.content:
Who: all Membership staff.

Policy: gift cards can only be purchased with CASH or CREDIT CARD. No EFT, no check.

Steps in Daxko:
1. Sell the gift card under the person PURCHASING it. If they're not a member, create a non-member unit first, then sell the card.
2. On the Account Balance page, open the drop-down on the "Add One-Time Fees" button and choose "Purchase Gift Card".
3. In the pop-up, enter the card amount and the gift card number (scan the barcode or type it). The system checks that the number hasn't been issued before.
4. Record the payment in that same window.

Good to know:
- Split payments aren't possible on one card — if someone wants to split payment, they must buy two separate cards.
- Organizations can purchase gift cards, but organizations cannot redeem them.

Source: SOP "General - Issuing a Gift Card", Sept 2026.

entries.title: Gift Cards — Redeeming and Using a Gift Card (SOP)
entries.content:
Who: all Membership staff.

Policy: gift cards have NO cash value.

Redeeming (a card must be redeemed before it can be used):
1. Go to the membership unit of the person redeeming the card.
2. On the "Add One-Time Fees" button's drop-down, choose "Redeem Gift Card".
3. Scan or type the barcode. The amount available on the card fills in automatically — no more than that amount can be redeemed.
4. The card number and redeemed amount are now tied to that membership unit. They show on the Account Balance screen under the available system credit totals (gift card credits only show if there are any).

Un-redeeming: click the "unassign" link to remove a card from the unit. If several cards are on the unit, you can remove specific ones. Partially used cards CANNOT be unassigned.

Using a redeemed gift card to pay:
- On the normal Make Payment screen, gift cards appear above the payment amount along with any system credits.
- Click "apply" next to the credit to use it ("unapply" to undo). Any amount left on the card or system credit is shown on the page.

Source: SOP "General - Redeeming a Gift Card", Sept 2026.

entries.title: Gift Certificates — Gift Certificate Log (by branch)
entries.content:
Gift certificates are tracked in the Gift Certificate Log Google Sheet (Y staff sign-in required):
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1tHdKDy_F8bDnnUYCsSfCCvSIC7-RO4--4p37GPQITcM/edit?usp=sharing

Each branch has its own tab with its own numbering:
- 10 - Northwest: NW001, NW002…
- 20 - Lohse: LO001…
- 30 - Tri-Y (Triangle Y): TY001…
- 40 - Lighthouse: LH001…
- 60 - Ott: Ott001…
- 78 - Youth Development: YD001…

When a certificate is sold, fill in on the next open number for your branch: date, purchaser's member # (if they have one), purchaser's first and last name, amount, the recipient's first and last name and member # (if applicable).
When it's redeemed, find the certificate # and fill in the Date Redeemed.

For questions about a specific certificate, look it up by certificate # in the log (don't share other people's details with the member).

Source: Gift Certificate Log, Sept 2026.

entries.title: Membership Fee Changes (Oct 1 & Nov 1, 2026) and the Bank Draft Discount (SOP)
entries.content:
THIS REPLACES OLDER PRICES ELSEWHERE IN THE KNOWLEDGE BASE ON THESE DATES. Audience: Front Desk, Membership, Business Office.

OCTOBER 1, 2026 — Program Membership changes to:
- Individual: $35
- Family: $70
(New rates go into the system the evening of Sept 30.)

NOVEMBER 1, 2026 — Facility membership rates (monthly):
- Family: $70 → $80
- Single Parent Family: $55 → $60
- Young Adult: $20 → $24
- Adult: $40 (no change)
- Youth: $15 (no change)

NEW BANK DRAFT DISCOUNT (starts Nov 1, 2026) — for members paying by Bank Account/EFT:
- Family: $78 (standard $80)
- Single Parent Family: $58.50 (standard $60)
- Young Adult: $23.40 (standard $24)
- Adult: $39.00 (standard $40)
- Youth: NOT eligible — never add the code to Youth memberships.
Members paying any other way pay the standard rate. Discount code name: "Bank Draft Discount". It is never automatic — it must be added manually. Members can have more than one discount code on an account.

NEW MEMBERS (joining or changing membership on/after Nov 1) — FRONT DESK adds the code:
1. Determine membership type.
2. Ask how they'll pay dues. Bank Account/EFT = eligible (unless Youth).
3. Complete registration, confirm the Bank Account/EFT payment method, manually add the "Bank Draft Discount" code.
4. Verify the discounted rate is showing and the payment method is set up correctly before completing registration. Don't assume the discount applied itself.

EXISTING MEMBERS switching to Bank Account/EFT — front desk does NOT add the code:
- Online: the member updates their billing method in their YMCA Daxko account on the YMCA of Southern Arizona website; the Business Office then adds the discount.
- In person: front desk confirms eligibility (not Youth), completes the Daxko Programs agreement "Membership-Billing Method Update", adds notes to the member's account, and submits it to the Business Office. The Business Office updates the billing method, adds the "Bank Draft Discount" code, and verifies the rate.

Business Office also uses Global Reports → Finance → Billing: Default Billing Method ties to Unit to find eligible existing members for November dues, and audits that EFT members have the code, Youth members don't, and rates are correct.

Member communication about these changes goes out October 1, 2026. Questions that can't be solved at the desk go to branch leadership or the Business Office (email or ticket system) before changing an existing member's account.

Quick reminder: BANK ACCOUNT/EFT = BANK DRAFT DISCOUNT. New member → front desk adds code. Existing member → Business Office adds code. Youth → never.

Source: SOP "Updated Fees 10.1.26 and Bank Draft Discount", Sept 2026.
